question: They are dirigins or adresinas:

options.opa: The cell adhesion molecules dependent on glycosylation (GlyCAM).
options.opb: The cell adhesion molecules of the immunoglobulin family (IgCAM).
options.opc: The molecules of vascular cell adhesion (VCAM).

analysis: Dirigins or adresinas are cell adhesion molecules of the immunoglobulin family (IgCAM).
